needs.what: Room split permanents (rule 709.5): one card with two doors (Secret Arcade {4}{W}, Dusty Parlor {2}{W}), castable as either half; the cast door enters unlocked and the other locked; a locked door's abilities are inactive; a sorcery-speed special action pays a locked door's mana cost to unlock it; name and mana value read only unlocked doors
needs.why_existing_wont_do: card_level_face_keys offers second_face/back_face, where the cast half becomes the whole object; nothing keeps both doors on one permanent with per-door locked/unlocked state, and no special action unlocks a door. Dusty Parlor's spell_cast trigger (filter types Enchantment, add_counters by mana_value_of the subject on an up_to target creature) is otherwise expressible but must only work while that door is unlocked

needs.what: a static that adds a card type in addition to other types to permanent spells you control on the stack as well as to nonland permanents you control ('Nonland permanents you control and permanent spells you control are enchantments in addition to their other types'), so the added Enchantment type is seen by spell_cast triggers and spell filters
needs.why_existing_wont_do: set_types replaces types rather than adding, add_subtype adds subtypes, and static affects filters read battlefield permanents only; nothing changes the card types of a spell on the stack
